starters.label: Blank
starters.description: An empty email with one text block.

starters.label: Notification
starters.description: A status tracker: where the request is, a status pill and its details.

starters.label: Approval request
starters.description: A decision card: who asks, the amount in large type, the facts and two pill buttons.

starters.label: Password reset / code
starters.description: A narrow security card: a masked-password badge and a spaced-out code in a dashed box.

starters.label: Daily digest
starters.description: A card per update from a datalist, filtered to yesterday and today.

starters.label: Alert / incident
starters.description: An incident log: a red stripe, a severity pill, the facts and a timeline of updates.

starters.label: Newsletter
starters.description: Masthead outside the card, a navbar, a hero lead story and two article cards.

starters.label: Announcement
starters.description: A company memo: a TO / FROM / DATE / RE header, a heavy rule and an initialled signature.

starters.label: Promotion
starters.description: A hero with the offer, a coupon code, three benefits and an unsubscribe footer.

starters.label: HR policy update
starters.description: A change checklist: numbered change cards and an acknowledgement box.

starters.label: Event invitation
starters.description: A poster: an oversized typographic date on a colour block, three facts and a black button.

starters.label: Feature announcement
starters.description: A hero introducing the feature, a screenshot, three benefits and a call to action.

starters.label: Welcome / onboarding
starters.description: Logo above the card, a welcome banner, login details and a support footer.

starters.label: Receipt / order confirmation
starters.description: Order details and its line items from a datalist, with a total.

starters.label: Weekly task report
starters.description: The week's tasks from a datalist as cards, with status and due date.

starters.label: Feedback request
starters.description: One question and a 1 to 5 scale to tap, in soft pastel cards.

starters.label: Midnight launch
starters.description: A dark, high-contrast launch: a glowing badge, a huge headline and a bento grid of features.

starters.label: Editorial
starters.description: A magazine layout: serif masthead between rules, a drop cap, a pull quote and a numbered contents list.

starters.label: Month at a glance
starters.description: A report card: three big-number tiles, progress bars and highlights.

starters.label: Event ticket
starters.description: An invitation as a ticket: a date stub, a dashed perforation and an admit-one line.

starters.label: Bold notice
starters.description: A loud, no-nonsense notice: yellow page, heavy type, a black time band and bordered tiles.

starters.label: Build report
starters.description: A terminal: green monospace commands, passed and failed steps, and the commit that triggered it.

starters.label: We miss you
starters.description: Sunset colour bands that fade from peach to plum, a warm message and a comeback offer.

starters.label: Quarterly update
starters.description: A Swiss grid: huge numerals, one red accent, thin rules and strict left alignment.

starters.label: Achievement
starters.description: A playful badge 'sticker', pastel bubbles for the stats and a pill button to share.

starters.label: VIP invitation
starters.description: Black and gold: serif type, thin gold rules, wide letter-spacing and a single gold button.

starters.label: Meeting agenda
starters.description: A timeline: times down the left, a line with dots, and each item with its owner.
